verdict: Consider it if you prefer a larger chronograph dial and a brown leather strap. Check the fit and seller details before choosing.
paragraphs: Fossil’s CH2885 specification lists a quartz chronograph movement, a 44 mm stainless-steel case, a black dial and a brown leather strap. It also lists a 22 mm strap width and mineral crystal. These are manufacturer specifications; SAT has not worn or tested this watch.

The combination is worth comparing if you want a leather-strap chronograph rather than a simple dial. The 44 mm case is an important fit consideration, especially if you prefer smaller watches. Ask about the fit or try a similar case size before buying.

The model is listed at 10 ATM by Fossil. Follow the exact model’s care instructions and check how to care for its leather strap.
